About the Scholarship

UIII (Universitas Islam Internasional Indonesia) is a graduate-only university near Jakarta offering MA and PhD programmes across four faculties, with full scholarships for admitted international students. Its admissions portal runs early-bird and regular rounds for the 2027-2028 academic year.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

UIII (Universitas Islam Internasional Indonesia) is a graduate-only university near Jakarta offering MA and PhD programmes across four faculties, with full scholarships for admitted international students. Its admissions portal runs early-bird and regular rounds for the 2027-2028 academic year.

Programme Highlights

  • Fully funded MA and PhD places including accommodation and airfare
  • Four faculties: Islamic studies, economics, social sciences and political science
  • English-medium graduate education with international faculty
  • Rolling rounds with early-bird advantages

Who Should Apply

Bachelor's (for MA) or master's (for PhD) graduates in the humanities and social sciences with interest in Islamic-world studies contexts; English documentation required.

Funding and Costs

Full scholarship package: tuition waiver, monthly living allowance, on-campus accommodation and return airfare for selected students.

Deadline and How to Apply

Create an account on the UIII admissions portal and submit in an early round to maximise scholarship consideration. Key deadline information: Rolling admission rounds for 2027-2028 with early-bird and regular deadlines announced on the admissions portal.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Universitas Islam Internasional Indonesia (UIII)

UIII is Indonesia's international Islamic university, a graduate-only institution near Jakarta offering fully funded MA and PhD programmes with a global student body.

Official website: https://uiii.ac.id

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Rolling admission rounds - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
